dedupe_keys.name: rseg satellite extended grdc monthly river discharge

description: The University of Stuttgart HydroSat team publishes the RSEG extension of Global Runoff Data Centre monthly river-discharge series at a DaRUS DOI. The own repository and DOI metadata state CC BY 4.0. The article reports extended estimates for 3,377 of 6,015 GRDC stations, using legacy gauge series with satellite river-width and water-height observations. The NetCDF file includes station identifiers, coordinates and uncertainty information; the deposit also contains MATLAB source code for its mapping algorithm. These series can help calibrate basin flow or flood-exposure simulations when active gauges are sparse. A caveat is that the published estimates are less accurate for low-discharge reaches and cannot be treated as direct gauge observations. The underlying GRDC data have separate access conditions. I read the own DaRUS page, DOI metadata and article Data Records without downloading the NetCDF file, testing the code or checking station-level skill. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
